title: One Quiet Thought
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
My thoughts go spinning round and round
Like leaves that will not land;
But I can turn them, one by one,
To Heavenly Father's hand.

[Chorus]
One quiet thought of Him tonight
And all the buzzing stills;
He keeps me in a perfect peace
As quiet as the hills.

[Verse 2]
When something big is coming soon
And worry starts to grow,
I think of how He loves me still
And whisper what I know.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Isaiah found the secret out
And gave it all away:
A mind that stays on Him is kept
In peace both night and day.

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
So now my thinking settles down
The way a feather falls;
He holds the night, He holds the house,
He holds me through it all.

[Chorus]
mood: Settling music. A figure that begins a shade too quick and spreads wider with every verse, the way a child's breathing slows when somebody counts along with it. A small celtic harp turning that figure over and over while a cello holds one low note underneath that never moves, so everything restless has something steady to come back to. It travels from circling to still, and the last verse should sound like a room where nothing more is going to happen tonight.
